Name: Bald is Beautiful - Susan from SVE
Author: bassooniraptor
Description:
I just felt like Susan would look stunning with a shaved head, so here she is in all her glory. I think I was inspired by the amazing T'Nia Miller (actress in Haunting of Bly Manor/Fall of the House of Usher, etc.)

I deserve 0.00000001% credit. Firstly, Susan is a mod character from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Secondly, I used the brilliant and wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14851]Diverse Stardew Valley SVE[/url] as the basis, which I HIGHLY recommend you use if you even remotely like this face. Even though it's no longer supported, it still functions perfectly well and the designs are beautiful. Thirdly, the seasonal changes are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic SVE[/url] and also used in  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14851]Diverse Stardew Valley SVE[/url] (which also has festival outfits. Even better!)

To install, open up the assets folder of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic SVE[/url] if you use it) and drag the corresponding assets folder from this mod. Let it overwrite the files when prompted, and voila.
